# WhatsCR

> WhatsCR is a 100% free, copyright-free and royalty-free music and audio library providing high-quality MP3 sound effects, gaming audio, 8-bit chiptune, lo-fi beats, and seamless game loops for video creators, game developers, and streamers.

## Overview
- Website: https://whatscr.eu/
- Cost: 100% Free, no subscription, no credit card required.
- Commercial Rights: Fully cleared for commercial monetization on YouTube, Twitch, TikTok, indie game development, podcasts, and commercial apps without copyright strikes or Content ID claims.
- Audio Formats: High-bitrate MP3, WAV, and OGG formats with integrated waveform audio preview.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- Is music on WhatsCR really copyright-free? Yes, all music and sound effects on WhatsCR are 100% copyright-free and royalty-free.
- Can I use WhatsCR tracks in monetized YouTube videos? Yes, tracks are safe for monetization on YouTube, Twitch, and all video streaming platforms without copyright strikes.
- Can game developers use WhatsCR loops in commercial games? Yes, all tracks and loops can be bundled and distributed in commercial video games across Steam, itch.io, iOS, Android, and consoles.
- Do users need an account to download? No, downloading audio files is instant and free without mandatory registration.
